description: Free. Fetch the exact published AuthiChain v0.1 JWS from the signed-record registry and pass it to the canonical edge-router verifier. Checks signature, issuer trust, durable revocation/status, expiry, and signed decision. Supply expectedObjectId to bind the record to a scanned object identifier. A valid signed claim alone does not prove physical authenticity.

assetId.description: Unique attestation ID or exact seal/product identifier

expectedObjectId.description: Optional independently observed object ID to compare with the signed subject

name: verify_attestation
